bagPolicy.summary: Clear totes up to 12" x 6" x 12", one-gallon clear freezer bags and clutches up to 6" x 9" are allowed. All other bags are prohibited.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 12" x 6" x 12"
prohibited: Any bag that is not clear
bagPolicy.note: This is the Iowa State Athletics policy for all ticketed events at Hilton Coliseum. Logos on clear totes can be no larger than 4.5" x 3.5". Exceptions are made for medical, family and child care needs.

ticketPickup.summary: For Cyclones athletics, the public Will-Call window is at the Athletics Ticket Office on the north end of the Jacobson Building. It opens one hour before the event and stays open through halftime. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.summary: For Cyclones games, all doors open to the public 60 minutes before game time. For men's basketball, the north student doors open 90 minutes before tipoff for student ticket holders. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
